source: Actual user messages in this conversation; no platform message timestamp invented.

decisions.quote: 我授權你用最佳的方式處理
decisions.interpretation: One fixed candidate offline replay and reverse tests, plus one live session of at most six non-download scroll calls; historic three attempts retained.

decisions.quote: 跳過獨立審查，直接撰寫一個精準的交接文件，必須確保低階模型可以沒有遺漏的實作
decisions.interpretation: No new independent Handoff review; later user supplement establishes existing Plan Review PASS and retains required pre-live review and final independent Acceptance.

decisions.quote: 實機前獨立程式／證據審查與最終獨立 Acceptance 仍為必要
decisions.interpretation: Preserve the exact four local review artifacts and their conditions.

decisions.quote: 完成後，使用一個subagent(GPT6-luna 推理模式xhigh)深度梳理上下文，撰寫一個詳細的git 提交訊息，必須包含意圖、你做了什麼、下一步建議，接著執行add,commit
decisions.interpretation: After handoff delivery, one read-only context/message subagent, then stage and commit only this handoff packet and directly related supplied Plan/review artifacts. No push. No implementation edits authorized in this delivery turn.

decisions.quote: 包含「 LINE 相簿盤點診斷：替代證據規則」都要commit進去
decisions.interpretation: Include plan-as-submitted.md and directly cited review artifacts in the same document commit.

decisions.quote: 你必須在此文件的最前面撰寫一段精準的交接prompt用來交代接手的Agent可以完成此任務
decisions.interpretation: handoff.md begins with a complete copyable Implementer prompt.

independent_plan_review: Existing local PASS with null plan_contract_sha256; not controller-native admission.
